fact: Themberchaud deposited the party at the docks with a thunderous landing.
source_quote: Themberchaud deposited the party at the docks with a thunderous, ungainly landing.
subject: Themberchaud's arrival

fact: Themberchaud roared and used his frightful presence to terrify the locals.
source_quote: He roared for good measure and used his frightful presence to terrify the locals.
subject: Themberchaud

fact: Gyrgum promised Themberchaud they would search the docks far and wide.
source_quote: Gyrgum promised to "search the docks far and wide"
subject: Gyrgum

fact: Themberchaud flew off toward his lair.

subject: Themberchaud departs

fact: A lone Duergar guard stepped forward and raised his hand to halt the party.
source_quote: A lone Duergar guard stepped forward, trembling but dutiful, and raised his hand to halt them
subject: Duergar guard

fact: The Duergar guard halted the party in the name of the Deepking.
source_quote: halt them in the name of the Deepking.
subject: guard halts party

source_quote: Gyrgum's attempt to pass "in the name of Themberchaud" failed
subject: Gyrgum

subject: Gyrgum's failed check

source_quote: The guard counters that Themberchaud is a servant of the Deepking.
subject: Duergar guard

fact: The guard carried a wanted poster.
source_quote: The guard pulled out a wanted poster
subject: wanted poster

fact: The guard recognized the party's faces as those of the Ember Vanguard.
source_quote: recognized the party's faces as those of the Ember Vanguard.
subject: guard recognition

source_quote: claiming they were undercover agents impersonating the Ember Vanguard to lure out the real threat.

subject: Thorin

subject: caltrop

source_quote: pressed it into the guard's hand as a secret symbol of the conspiracy, officially "deputizing" him.
subject: deputizing guard
